format.decoder: opendbc per-vehicle profile (Ford, officially supported port; carstate.py populates ret.yawRate from Yaw_Data_FD1.VehYaw_W_Actl)

rates_hint.note: Ford CAN: yawRate populated directly from CAN (Yaw_Data_FD1.VehYaw_W_Actl, rad/s). Lateral accel (VehLatComp_A_Actl) and roll rate are present in ford_lincoln_base_pt.dbc but not currently piped into cereal carState — small carstate.py patch surfaces them.
